skill: Read template-contract first. Assign the original template ID; readers receive the language version. get-template reports translation.originalId, translations, missingLanguages and editor ownership. Use translate-template to open/create a version, then get-template and save-template on that version. If the translation plugin owns editing, use its reported editor URL and do not bypass the refusal. Shared headers/footers have their own translations through translate-synced-pattern; place the original pattern ID in templates so each reader receives the correct language. Native content-slot attributes and other saved block markup must be preserved. Theme-file rules (contentSource) are shared by the original and all translations and are set in wp-admin; never create per-language templates for them.
